spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m9p6t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, Runways, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES gepoch, ctrlEpoch, owner, ownerEpoch
vars == <<gepoch, ctrlEpoch, owner, ownerEpoch>>

NoOwner == "free"

TypeOK ==
    /\ gepoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ ctrlEpoch \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ owner \in [Runways -> Controllers \cup {NoOwner}]
    /\ ownerEpoch \in [Runways -> 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ gepoch = 0
    /\ ctrlEpoch = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ owner = [r \in Runways |-> NoOwner]
    /\ ownerEpoch = [r \in Runways |-> 0]

\* Authority is reassigned: bump the global epoch and let one controller
\* learn the new value immediately (the others fall behind and go stale).
Reconfigure(c) ==
    /\ gepoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ gepoch' = gepoch + 1
    /\ ctrlEpoch' = [ctrlEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = gepoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ownerEpoch>>

\* A lagging controller catches up to the live epoch.
Sync(c) ==
    /\ ctrlEpoch[c] < gepoch
    /\ ctrlEpoch' = [ctrlEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = gepoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, owner, ownerEpoch>>

\* A controller allocates a free runway ONLY while it is current, recording
\* the live epoch on the runway.
Allocate(c, r) ==
    /\ owner[r] = NoOwner
    /\ ctrlEpoch[c] = gepoch
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ ownerEpoch' = [ownerEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = gepoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, ctrlEpoch>>

\* A controller frees a runway it holds.
Release(c, r) ==
    /\ owner[r] = c
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = NoOwner]
    /\ ownerEpoch' = [ownerEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, ctrlEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Reconfigure(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Sync(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Runways : Allocate(c, r)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Runways : Release(c, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No controller holds a slot it took while stale: the epoch recorded on a
\* held runway never exceeds what its owner currently knows.
NoStaleHold ==
    \A r \in Runways :
        owner[r] # NoOwner => ownerEpoch[r] <= ctrlEpoch[owner[r]]
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m6p3t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Agents, Slots, MaxClock, LeaseLen
ASSUME MaxClock \in Nat /\ LeaseLen \in Nat

VARIABLES clock, owner, expiry, claim
vars == <<clock, owner, expiry, claim>>

Nobody == "nobody"
NoSlot == "noslot"

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Agents \cup {Nobody}]
    /\ expiry \in [Slots -> 0..(MaxClock + LeaseLen)]
    /\ claim \in [Agents -> Slots \cup {NoSlot}]

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> Nobody]
    /\ expiry = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ claim = [a \in Agents |-> NoSlot]

Lapsed(s) == owner[s] = Nobody \/ expiry[s] <= clock

\* Acquire a free or lapsed slot; acquiring evicts any stale claim on it.
Acquire(a, s) ==
    /\ claim[a] = NoSlot
    /\ Lapsed(s)
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = a]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ claim' = [x \in Agents |->
                    IF x = a THEN s
                    ELSE IF claim[x] = s THEN NoSlot
                    ELSE claim[x]]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

\* Extend a lease the agent still legitimately holds.
Renew(a, s) ==
    /\ claim[a] = s
    /\ owner[s] = a
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, owner, claim>>

\* Voluntarily give up a held slot.
Release(a, s) ==
    /\ claim[a] = s
    /\ owner[s] = a
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = Nobody]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![a] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry>>

\* The privileged admin forcibly clears a slot and cancels all claims on it.
AdminOverride(s) ==
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = Nobody]
    /\ claim' = [x \in Agents |-> IF claim[x] = s THEN NoSlot ELSE claim[x]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, claim>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents, s \in Slots : Acquire(a, s)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, s \in Slots : Renew(a, s)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, s \in Slots : Release(a, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AdminOverride(s)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Two distinct agents never hold a claim on the same slot at once.
NoDoubleClaim ==
    \A a, b \in Agents :
        (claim[a] # NoSlot /\ claim[a] = claim[b]) => a = b
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Agents = {a1, a2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxClock = 3
    LeaseLen = 2
INVARIANT NoDoubleClaim
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m1p4t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Instances, NodeCount, Cap, MaxReq
ASSUME NodeCount \in Nat /\ Cap \in Nat /\ MaxReq \in Nat

Nodes == 0..(NodeCount - 1)
Succ(n) == (n + 1) % NodeCount

VARIABLES tok, load, pending, online
vars == <<tok, load, pending, online>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ tok \in [Instances -> Nodes]
    /\ load \in [Nodes -> 0..(Cap + 2)]
    /\ pending \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxReq]
    /\ online \in [Instances -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ tok = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ load = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ pending = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ online = [i \in Instances |-> TRUE]

\* External demand piles up at a node.
RaiseDemand(n) ==
    /\ pending[n] < MaxReq
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![n] = pending[n] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, load, online>>

\* The token advances one step around the ring.
PassToken(i) ==
    /\ tok' = [tok EXCEPT ![i] = Succ(tok[i])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, pending, online>>

\* The token holder sheds one demand unit onto its node, respecting capacity.
Serve(i, n) ==
    /\ online[i]
    /\ tok[i] = n
    /\ pending[n] > 0
    /\ load[n] < Cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![n] = load[n] + 1]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![n] = pending[n] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, online>>

\* The token holder relieves one unit of load from its node.
Relieve(i, n) ==
    /\ tok[i] = n
    /\ load[n] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![n] = load[n] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, pending, online>>

\* An instance drops offline or comes back.
Toggle(i) ==
    /\ online' = [online EXCEPT ![i] = ~online[i]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, load, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : RaiseDemand(n)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : PassToken(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, n \in Nodes : Serve(i, n)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, n \in Nodes : Relieve(i, n)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Toggle(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Capacity is never exceeded at any node.
BoundedCapacity == \A n \in Nodes : load[n] <= Cap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {i1, i2}
    NodeCount = 2
    Cap = 2
    MaxReq = 2
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m7p6t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Banks, MaxVer, Modulus
ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat /\ Modulus \in Nat

NoWriter == "none"
Engine == "engine"

VARIABLES regVal, regVer, observed, writerObs, lastWriter
vars == <<regVal, regVer, observed, writerObs, lastWriter>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ regVal \in 0..(Modulus - 1)
    /\ regVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ observed \in [Banks -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ writerObs \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ lastWriter \in Banks \cup {NoWriter, Engine}

Init ==
    /\ regVal = 0
    /\ regVer = 0
    /\ observed = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ writerObs = 0
    /\ lastWriter = NoWriter

\* A bank snapshots the current version.
Read(b) ==
    /\ observed' = [observed EXCEPT ![b] = regVer]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regVal, regVer, writerObs, lastWriter>>

\* Compare-and-swap: the bank commits only if its snapshot is still live.
Commit(b) ==
    /\ regVer < MaxVer
    /\ observed[b] = regVer
    /\ regVal' = (regVal + 1) % Modulus
    /\ regVer' = regVer + 1
    /\ writerObs' = observed[b]
    /\ lastWriter' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED observed

\* The authoritative settlement engine posts an update, moving the version on.
EnginePost ==
    /\ regVer < MaxVer
    /\ regVal' = (regVal + 2) % Modulus
    /\ regVer' = regVer + 1
    /\ writerObs' = regVer
    /\ lastWriter' = Engine
    /\ UNCHANGED observed

\* A bank that fell behind discards its stale snapshot.
Abort(b) ==
    /\ observed[b] # 0
    /\ observed[b] < regVer
    /\ observed' = [observed EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regVal, regVer, writerObs, lastWriter>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Read(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Commit(b)
    \/ EnginePost
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Abort(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No stale writer ever committed: the last writer observed the version just
\* prior to the one it installed.
NoStaleCommit ==
    lastWriter # NoWriter => writerObs = regVer - 1
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {b1, b2}
    MaxVer = 3
    Modulus = 3
INVARIANT NoStaleCommit
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m1p2t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Courses, InstCount, Cap, MaxWL
ASSUME InstCount \in Nat /\ Cap \in Nat /\ MaxWL \in Nat

Instances == 0..(InstCount - 1)
NextInst(i) == (i + 1) % InstCount

VARIABLES tok, enrolled, free, waitlist
vars == <<tok, enrolled, free, waitlist>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ tok \in Instances
    /\ enrolled \in [Courses -> 0..Cap]
    /\ free \in [Courses -> 0..Cap]
    /\ waitlist \in [Courses -> 0..MaxWL]

Init ==
    /\ tok = 0
    /\ enrolled = [c \in Courses |-> 0]
    /\ free = [c \in Courses |-> Cap]
    /\ waitlist = [c \in Courses |-> 0]

\* The registration token advances to the next instance on the ring.
PassToken ==
    /\ tok' = NextInst(tok)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, free, waitlist>>

\* The token holder enrolls a student, consuming one free seat.
Enroll(i, c) ==
    /\ tok = i
    /\ free[c] > 0
    /\ enrolled' = [enrolled EXCEPT ![c] = enrolled[c] + 1]
    /\ free' = [free EXCEPT ![c] = free[c] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, waitlist>>

\* The token holder drops a student, returning one free seat.
Drop(i, c) ==
    /\ tok = i
    /\ enrolled[c] > 0
    /\ enrolled' = [enrolled EXCEPT ![c] = enrolled[c] - 1]
    /\ free' = [free EXCEPT ![c] = free[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, waitlist>>

\* A student joins the waitlist of a full course.
JoinWaitlist(c) ==
    /\ free[c] = 0
    /\ waitlist[c] < MaxWL
    /\ waitlist' = [waitlist EXCEPT ![c] = waitlist[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tok, enrolled, free>>

\* A waitlisted student is promoted into a freshly opened seat.
Promote(i, c) ==
    /\ tok = i
    /\ waitlist[c] > 0
    /\ free[c] > 0
    /\ waitlist' = [waitlist EXCEPT ![c] = waitlist[c] - 1]
    /\ free' = [free EXCEPT ![c] = free[c] - 1]
    /\ enrolled' = [enrolled EXCEPT ![c] = enrolled[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED tok

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E i \in Instances, c \in Courses : Enroll(i, c)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, c \in Courses : Drop(i, c)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : JoinWaitlist(c)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, c \in Courses : Promote(i, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Seats are conserved: free plus enrolled equals capacity for every course.
SeatsConserved == \A c \in Courses : free[c] + enrolled[c] = Cap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Courses = {cs1, cs2}
    InstCount = 2
    Cap = 2
    MaxWL = 2
INVARIANT SeatsConserved
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m3p1t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Updates
NoLeader == "none"

VARIABLES leader, alive, applied, acked
vars == <<leader, alive, applied, acked>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NoLeader}
    /\ alive \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ applied \in SUBSET Updates
    /\ acked \in SUBSET Updates

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ alive = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ acked = {}

\* A live node is elected leader when the post is vacant.
Elect(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, applied, acked>>

\* A node crashes silently; if it was leader, the post falls vacant.
Crash(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN NoLeader ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, acked>>

\* A crashed node recovers and rejoins.
Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, applied, acked>>

\* The leader applies a submitted update into the durable record.
Apply(u) ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, acked>>

\* A client acknowledges an update it has observed in the record as committed.
Ack(u) ==
    /\ u \in applied
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, applied>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Apply(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Ack(u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No acknowledged update is ever lost from the shared record.
DurableAcks == acked \subseteq applied
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m7p6t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Hubs, MaxTag, MaxUnits
ASSUME MaxTag \in Nat /\ MaxUnits \in Nat

NoActor == "none"
Depot == "depot"

VARIABLES units, tag, snapshot, actor, actorTag
vars == <<units, tag, snapshot, actor, actorTag>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ units \in 0..MaxUnits
    /\ tag \in 0..MaxTag
    /\ snapshot \in [Hubs -> 0..MaxTag]
    /\ actor \in Hubs \cup {NoActor, Depot}
    /\ actorTag \in 0..MaxTag

Init ==
    /\ units = 1
    /\ tag = 0
    /\ snapshot = [h \in Hubs |-> 0]
    /\ actor = NoActor
    /\ actorTag = 0

\* A hub snapshots the live tag.
ReadTag(h) ==
    /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![h] = tag]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<units, tag, actor, actorTag>>

\* Compare-and-swap withdrawal: succeeds only on a matching snapshot.
Withdraw(h) ==
    /\ snapshot[h] = tag
    /\ units > 0
    /\ tag < MaxTag
    /\ units' = units - 1
    /\ tag' = tag + 1
    /\ actor' = h
    /\ actorTag' = snapshot[h]
    /\ UNCHANGED snapshot

\* The depot deposits a fresh unit, advancing the tag.
Deposit ==
    /\ units < MaxUnits
    /\ tag < MaxTag
    /\ units' = units + 1
    /\ tag' = tag + 1
    /\ actor' = Depot
    /\ actorTag' = tag
    /\ UNCHANGED snapshot

\* A hub discards an outdated snapshot.
Expire(h) ==
    /\ snapshot[h] < tag
    /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![h] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<units, tag, actor, actorTag>>

Next ==
    \/ \E h \in Hubs : ReadTag(h)
    \/ \E h \in Hubs : Withdraw(h)
    \/ Deposit
    \/ \E h \in Hubs : Expire(h)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No hub ever committed on a stale snapshot.
NoStaleWithdrawal ==
    actor # NoActor => actorTag = tag - 1
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Hubs = {h1, h2}
    MaxTag = 3
    MaxUnits = 2
INVARIANT NoStaleWithdrawal
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m3p4t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, Cap, MaxQueue
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ MaxQueue \in Nat

Vacant == "vacant"

VARIABLES leader, alive, onLine, queued
vars == <<leader, alive, onLine, queued>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Controllers \cup {Vacant}
    /\ alive \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ onLine \in 0..(Cap + 2)
    /\ queued \in 0..MaxQueue

Init ==
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ alive = [c \in Controllers |-> TRUE]
    /\ onLine = 0
    /\ queued = 0

\* A live controller takes the vacant leadership.
Elect(c) ==
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, onLine, queued>>

\* A controller crashes; leadership is vacated if it held it.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = c THEN Vacant ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onLine, queued>>

\* A crashed controller recovers.
Recover(c) ==
    /\ ~alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, onLine, queued>>

\* A car arrives into the holding queue.
Arrive ==
    /\ queued < MaxQueue
    /\ queued' = queued + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, onLine>>

\* The leader admits a queued car onto the line, respecting capacity.
Admit(c) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ queued > 0
    /\ onLine < Cap
    /\ onLine' = onLine + 1
    /\ queued' = queued - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

\* A finished car exits the line.
Exit ==
    /\ onLine > 0
    /\ onLine' = onLine - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, queued>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Recover(c)
    \/ Arrive
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Admit(c)
    \/ Exit

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The line never holds more cars than its capacity.
LineWithinCapacity == onLine <= Cap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2}
    Cap = 3
    MaxQueue = 2
INVARIANT LineWithinCapacity
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m3p3t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Jobs, Printers
Vacant == "vacant"
NoJob == "nojob"
NoSlot == "noslot"

VARIABLES leader, alive, slotJob, jobSlot, msgs
vars == <<leader, alive, slotJob, jobSlot, msgs>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {Vacant}
    /\ alive \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ slotJob \in [Printers -> Jobs \cup {NoJob}]
    /\ jobSlot \in [Jobs -> Printers \cup {NoSlot}]
    /\ msgs \in SUBSET (Jobs \X Printers)

Init ==
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ alive = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ slotJob = [p \in Printers |-> NoJob]
    /\ jobSlot = [j \in Jobs |-> NoSlot]
    /\ msgs = {}

Elect(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, slotJob, jobSlot, msgs>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN Vacant ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotJob, jobSlot, msgs>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, slotJob, jobSlot, msgs>>

\* The leader proposes an assignment onto the unordered channel.
Propose(j, p) ==
    /\ leader # Vacant
    /\ jobSlot[j] = NoSlot
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<<j, p>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, slotJob, jobSlot>>

\* An assignment message is applied only if both sides are still free.
Deliver(j, p) ==
    /\ <<j, p>> \in msgs
    /\ jobSlot[j] = NoSlot
    /\ slotJob[p] = NoJob
    /\ slotJob' = [slotJob EXCEPT ![p] = j]
    /\ jobSlot' = [jobSlot EXCEPT ![j] = p]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<<j, p>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

\* A finished job frees its slot and clears both records.
Complete(j) ==
    /\ jobSlot[j] # NoSlot
    /\ slotJob' = [slotJob EXCEPT ![jobSlot[j]] = NoJob]
    /\ jobSlot' = [jobSlot EXCEPT ![j] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, p \in Printers : Propose(j, p)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, p \in Printers : Deliver(j, p)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Complete(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The two directional records are mutual inverses at all times.
InverseConsistent ==
    /\ \A p \in Printers : slotJob[p] # NoJob => jobSlot[slotJob[p]] = p
    /\ \A j \in Jobs : jobSlot[j] # NoSlot => slotJob[jobSlot[j]] = j
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m4p6t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, MaxQ, MaxTok
ASSUME MaxQ \in Nat /\ MaxTok \in Nat

NoWorker == "none"

VARIABLES qlen, capToken, heldTok, lastWorker, lastTok
vars == <<qlen, capToken, heldTok, lastWorker, lastTok>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ qlen \in 0..MaxQ
    /\ capToken \in 0..MaxTok
    /\ heldTok \in [Workers -> 0..MaxTok]
    /\ lastWorker \in Workers \cup {NoWorker}
    /\ lastTok \in 0..MaxTok

Init ==
    /\ qlen = 0
    /\ capToken = 0
    /\ heldTok = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ lastWorker = NoWorker
    /\ lastTok = 0

\* Enqueue a restock task, subject to backpressure when full.
Enqueue ==
    /\ qlen < MaxQ
    /\ qlen' = qlen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<capToken, heldTok, lastWorker, lastTok>>

\* A worker syncs to the current authorization token.
Sync(w) ==
    /\ heldTok' = [heldTok EXCEPT ![w] = capToken]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, capToken, lastWorker, lastTok>>

\* A slow worker drifts and loses its synced token.
LoseSync(w) ==
    /\ heldTok[w] > 0
    /\ heldTok' = [heldTok EXCEPT ![w] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, capToken, lastWorker, lastTok>>

\* A current worker drains one task; the authorization token then advances.
Process(w) ==
    /\ qlen > 0
    /\ capToken < MaxTok
    /\ heldTok[w] = capToken
    /\ qlen' = qlen - 1
    /\ capToken' = capToken + 1
    /\ lastWorker' = w
    /\ lastTok' = heldTok[w]
    /\ UNCHANGED heldTok

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Sync(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : LoseSync(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Process(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No stale worker ever drained the queue.
NoStaleDrain == lastWorker # NoWorker => lastTok = capToken - 1
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    MaxQ = 2
    MaxTok = 3
INVARIANT NoStaleDrain
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m9p3t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Bags, Chutes, MaxEpoch
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

Empty == "empty"

VARIABLES epoch, chuteBag, routed, msgs
vars == <<epoch, chuteBag, routed, msgs>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ chuteBag \in [Chutes -> Bags \cup {Empty}]
    /\ routed \in [Bags -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ msgs \in SUBSET (Bags \X Chutes)

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ chuteBag = [c \in Chutes |-> Empty]
    /\ routed = [b \in Bags |-> FALSE]
    /\ msgs = {}

\* A routing decision is emitted onto the unordered fabric.
Route(b, c) ==
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<<b, c>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, chuteBag, routed>>

\* A routing message is applied only if the slot is empty and the bag is
\* not already routed somewhere.
Deliver(b, c) ==
    /\ <<b, c>> \in msgs
    /\ chuteBag[c] = Empty
    /\ ~routed[b]
    /\ chuteBag' = [chuteBag EXCEPT ![c] = b]
    /\ routed' = [routed EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<<b, c>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

\* A bag is unloaded from its chute.
Unload(c) ==
    /\ chuteBag[c] # Empty
    /\ routed' = [routed EXCEPT ![chuteBag[c]] = FALSE]
    /\ chuteBag' = [chuteBag EXCEPT ![c] = Empty]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, msgs>>

\* Epoch reconfiguration tears down all assignments and flushes the fabric.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ chuteBag' = [c \in Chutes |-> Empty]
    /\ routed' = [b \in Bags |-> FALSE]
    /\ msgs' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Chutes : Route(b, c)
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Chutes : Deliver(b, c)
    \/ \E c \in Chutes : Unload(c)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No bag occupies two chute slots at once.
NoDoubleRoute ==
    \A c1, c2 \in Chutes :
        (chuteBag[c1] # Empty /\ chuteBag[c1] = chuteBag[c2]) => c1 = c2
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m2p5t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Participants

VARIABLES phase, votes, alive, done, fired
vars == <<phase, votes, alive, done, fired>>

Phases == {"init", "collecting", "committed", "aborted"}
Ballots == {"none", "yes", "no"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ votes \in [Participants -> Ballots]
    /\ alive \in [Participants -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ done \in BOOLEAN
    /\ fired \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ phase = "init"
    /\ votes = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
    /\ alive = [p \in Participants |-> TRUE]
    /\ done = FALSE
    /\ fired = 0

\* Open the voting round.
Start ==
    /\ phase = "init"
    /\ phase' = "collecting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, alive, done, fired>>

\* A live participant casts its ballot.
Vote(p, b) ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ alive[p]
    /\ votes[p] = "none"
    /\ b \in {"yes", "no"}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, alive, done, fired>>

\* A participant crashes silently.
Crash(p) ==
    /\ alive[p]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, done, fired>>

\* A crashed participant recovers.
Recover(p) ==
    /\ ~alive[p]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, done, fired>>

\* Commit only if everyone is alive and voted yes.
Commit ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ \A p \in Participants : alive[p] /\ votes[p] = "yes"
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, alive, done, fired>>

\* Abort on a no-vote or a crashed unvoted participant.
Abort ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ \E p \in Participants : votes[p] = "no" \/ (~alive[p] /\ votes[p] = "none")
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, alive, done, fired>>

\* The one irreversible dispatch, only from a committed round, only once.
Dispatch ==
    /\ phase = "committed"
    /\ ~done
    /\ done' = TRUE
    /\ fired' = fired + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ Start
    \/ \E p \in Participants, b \in Ballots : Vote(p, b)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Recover(p)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Dispatch

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The irreversible dispatch fires at most once.
AtMostOneDispatch == fired <= 1
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Participants = {p1, p2}
INVARIANT AtMostOneDispatch
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m3p0t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes
Vacant == "vacant"
Free == "free"

VARIABLES leader, lock, pcs, alive
vars == <<leader, lock, pcs, alive>>

States == {"idle", "waiting", "critical"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {Vacant}
    /\ lock \in Nodes \cup {Free}
    /\ pcs \in [Nodes -> States]
    /\ alive \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ pcs = [n \in Nodes |-> "idle"]
    /\ alive = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]

\* A live node takes vacant leadership.
Elect(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, pcs, alive>>

\* An idle node asks for access.
Request(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ pcs[n] = "idle"
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![n] = "waiting"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, lock, alive>>

\* Only the leader may enter, and only when the lock is free.
Enter(n) ==
    /\ pcs[n] = "waiting"
    /\ leader = n
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ lock' = n
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![n] = "critical"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

\* Leave the critical section and release the lock.
Exit(n) ==
    /\ pcs[n] = "critical"
    /\ lock' = Free
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![n] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

\* Silent crash: drops leadership and lock if held.
Crash(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN Vacant ELSE leader
    /\ lock' = IF lock = n THEN Free ELSE lock
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![n] = "idle"]

\* A crashed node recovers.
Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, lock, pcs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Request(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Enter(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Exit(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Everyone in the critical section holds the single lock, so at most one is in.
MutualExclusion ==
    \A n \in Nodes : pcs[n] = "critical" => lock = n
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m9p1t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Locks, MaxEpoch, MaxVer
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxVer \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, stored, confirmed, nodeEpoch, alive
vars == <<epoch, stored, confirmed, nodeEpoch, alive>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ stored \in [Locks -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ confirmed \in [Locks -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ nodeEpoch \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ alive \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ stored = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ confirmed = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
    /\ nodeEpoch = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ alive = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]

\* Fencing reconfiguration bumps the live epoch.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, confirmed, nodeEpoch, alive>>

\* A node syncs to the live epoch.
Sync(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ nodeEpoch' = [nodeEpoch EXCEPT ![n] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, stored, confirmed, alive>>

\* Only a node fenced-in at the live epoch may push an update.
Push(n, l) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ nodeEpoch[n] = epoch
    /\ stored[l] < MaxVer
    /\ stored' = [stored EXCEPT ![l] = stored[l] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, confirmed, nodeEpoch, alive>>

\* A stored version is confirmed back to the homeowner.
Confirm(l) ==
    /\ confirmed' = [confirmed EXCEPT ![l] = stored[l]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, stored, nodeEpoch, alive>>

\* Silent crash drops the node's sync.
Crash(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ nodeEpoch' = [nodeEpoch EXCEPT ![n] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, stored, confirmed>>

\* A crashed node recovers.
Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, stored, confirmed, nodeEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Sync(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, l \in Locks : Push(n, l)
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Confirm(l)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A confirmed policy version is never lost from the stored record.
NoLostUpdate == \A l \in Locks : confirmed[l] <= stored[l]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    Locks = {l1, l2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxVer = 3
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m4p6t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, MaxQ, MaxInflight
ASSUME MaxQ \in Nat /\ MaxInflight \in Nat

NoRobot == "none"

VARIABLES qlen, authorized, lastPuller, inflight
vars == <<qlen, authorized, lastPuller, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ qlen \in 0..MaxQ
    /\ authorized \in SUBSET Robots
    /\ lastPuller \in Robots \cup {NoRobot}
    /\ inflight \in 0..MaxInflight

Init ==
    /\ qlen = 0
    /\ authorized = {}
    /\ lastPuller = NoRobot
    /\ inflight = 0

\* Enqueue a picking task, subject to backpressure.
Enqueue ==
    /\ qlen < MaxQ
    /\ qlen' = qlen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, lastPuller, inflight>>

\* The dispatcher grants pull authorization to a robot.
Grant(r) ==
    /\ r \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, lastPuller, inflight>>

\* The dispatcher fences out a lagging robot, clearing any stale record of it.
Revoke(r) ==
    /\ r \in authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {r}
    /\ lastPuller' = IF lastPuller = r THEN NoRobot ELSE lastPuller
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, inflight>>

\* Only an authorized robot may pull a task off the queue.
Pull(r) ==
    /\ r \in authorized
    /\ qlen > 0
    /\ inflight < MaxInflight
    /\ qlen' = qlen - 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight + 1
    /\ lastPuller' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED authorized

\* A robot finishes an in-flight task.
Complete ==
    /\ inflight > 0
    /\ inflight' = inflight - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, authorized, lastPuller>>

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Grant(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Revoke(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Pull(r)
    \/ Complete

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The most recent puller is always still authorized.
AuthorizedPuller == lastPuller # NoRobot => lastPuller \in authorized
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2}
    MaxQ = 2
    MaxInflight = 2
INVARIANT AuthorizedPuller
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m5p6t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Members, Quorum, MaxRound
ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ MaxRound \in Nat

VARIABLES tally, voteMsgs, confirmed, backing, round
vars == <<tally, voteMsgs, confirmed, backing, round>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ tally \in SUBSET Members
    /\ voteMsgs \in SUBSET Members
    /\ confirmed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ backing \in 0..Cardinality(Members)
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound

Init ==
    /\ tally = {}
    /\ voteMsgs = {}
    /\ confirmed = FALSE
    /\ backing = 0
    /\ round = 0

\* A member casts a vote onto the unordered fabric.
CastVote(m) ==
    /\ m \notin voteMsgs
    /\ voteMsgs' = voteMsgs \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, confirmed, backing, round>>

\* A pending vote is delivered and added to the tally.
DeliverVote(m) ==
    /\ m \in voteMsgs
    /\ tally' = tally \cup {m}
    /\ voteMsgs' = voteMsgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<confirmed, backing, round>>

\* Finalize the booking only once the tally reaches quorum.
Confirm ==
    /\ ~confirmed
    /\ Cardinality(tally) >= Quorum
    /\ confirmed' = TRUE
    /\ backing' = Cardinality(tally)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, voteMsgs, round>>

\* Open the next round, clearing the tally and flushing stale votes.
NewRound ==
    /\ confirmed
    /\ round < MaxRound
    /\ tally' = {}
    /\ voteMsgs' = {}
    /\ confirmed' = FALSE
    /\ round' = round + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED backing

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members : CastVote(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members : DeliverVote(m)
    \/ Confirm
    \/ NewRound

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No booking is confirmed without at least a quorum of approvals.
QuorumBacked == confirmed => backing >= Quorum
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Members = {m1, m2, m3}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxRound = 2
INVARIANT QuorumBacked
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m6p1t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Writers, N, MaxClock, LeaseLen
ASSUME N \in Nat /\ MaxClock \in Nat /\ LeaseLen \in Nat

SeqNums == 1..N
NoOwner == "none"

VARIABLES clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, msgs, applied, confirmedUpTo
vars == <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, msgs, applied, confirmedUpTo>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ leaseOwner \in Writers \cup {NoOwner}
    /\ leaseExp \in 0..(MaxClock + LeaseLen)
    /\ msgs \in SUBSET SeqNums
    /\ applied \in SUBSET SeqNums
    /\ confirmedUpTo \in 0..N

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ leaseOwner = NoOwner
    /\ leaseExp = 0
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ confirmedUpTo = 0

\* Take a fresh lease on the ledger.
Lease(w) ==
    /\ leaseOwner' = w
    /\ leaseExp' = clock + LeaseLen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, msgs, applied, confirmedUpTo>>

\* The live lease holder proposes applying an update number.
Send(w, i) ==
    /\ leaseOwner = w
    /\ leaseExp > clock
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, applied, confirmedUpTo>>

\* An update is applied to the ledger, possibly out of order.
Deliver(i) ==
    /\ i \in msgs
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {i}
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, confirmedUpTo>>

\* Extend the confirmed prefix only when the next number is already applied.
Confirm ==
    /\ confirmedUpTo < N
    /\ (confirmedUpTo + 1) \in applied
    /\ confirmedUpTo' = confirmedUpTo + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, leaseOwner, leaseExp, msgs, applied>>

\* Time advances, expiring leases.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseOwner, leaseExp, msgs, applied, confirmedUpTo>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Lease(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers, i \in SeqNums : Send(w, i)
    \/ \E i \in SeqNums : Deliver(i)
    \/ Confirm
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No confirmed update is missing from the ledger.
NoGap == \A i \in 1..confirmedUpTo : i \in applied
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Writers = {w1, w2}
    N = 3
    MaxClock = 3
    LeaseLen = 2
INVARIANT NoGap
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m4p5t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Instr, Settlers, MaxQ
ASSUME MaxQ \in Nat

NoOwner == "none"
Statuses == {"new", "queued", "settling", "settled"}

VARIABLES status, owner, settleTimes, qlen, busy
vars == <<status, owner, settleTimes, qlen, busy>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in [Instr -> Statuses]
    /\ owner \in [Instr -> Settlers \cup {NoOwner}]
    /\ settleTimes \in [Instr -> 0..2]
    /\ qlen \in 0..MaxQ
    /\ busy \in [Settlers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ status = [i \in Instr |-> "new"]
    /\ owner = [i \in Instr |-> NoOwner]
    /\ settleTimes = [i \in Instr |-> 0]
    /\ qlen = 0
    /\ busy = [s \in Settlers |-> FALSE]

\* Submit an instruction into the bounded queue.
Submit(i) ==
    /\ status[i] = "new"
    /\ qlen < MaxQ
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "queued"]
    /\ qlen' = qlen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, settleTimes, busy>>

\* An available settler claims a queued instruction.
Claim(s, i) ==
    /\ status[i] = "queued"
    /\ ~busy[s]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "settling"]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![i] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<settleTimes, qlen, busy>>

\* The owning settler irreversibly settles the instruction, once.
Settle(s, i) ==
    /\ status[i] = "settling"
    /\ owner[i] = s
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "settled"]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![i] = NoOwner]
    /\ settleTimes' = [settleTimes EXCEPT ![i] = settleTimes[i] + 1]
    /\ qlen' = qlen - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED busy

\* The dispatcher reclaims a slow settler's instruction, voiding its claim.
Reclaim(i) ==
    /\ status[i] = "settling"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "queued"]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![i] = NoOwner]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<settleTimes, qlen, busy>>

\* A settler flips between busy and available.
ToggleBusy(s) ==
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![s] = ~busy[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, owner, settleTimes, qlen>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instr : Submit(i)
    \/ \E s \in Settlers, i \in Instr : Claim(s, i)
    \/ \E s \in Settlers, i \in Instr : Settle(s, i)
    \/ \E i \in Instr : Reclaim(i)
    \/ \E s \in Settlers : ToggleBusy(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Each instruction is settled at most once.
AtMostOnceSettle == \A i \in Instr : settleTimes[i] <= 1
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m1p2t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS DroneCount, MsgIds, Total
ASSUME DroneCount \in Nat /\ Total \in Nat

Drones == 0..(DroneCount - 1)
Succ(d) == (d + 1) % DroneCount

VARIABLES token, depot, airborne, msgs
vars == <<token, depot, airborne, msgs>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Drones
    /\ depot \in 0..Total
    /\ airborne \in 0..Total
    /\ msgs \in SUBSET MsgIds

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ depot = Total
    /\ airborne = 0
    /\ msgs = {}

\* The dispatch token advances around the ring.
PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<depot, airborne, msgs>>

\* The token holder launches a fuel cell from the depot into transit.
Launch(d) ==
    /\ token = d
    /\ depot > 0
    /\ \E g \in MsgIds :
        /\ g \notin msgs
        /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {g}
    /\ depot' = depot - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, airborne>>

\* An in-transit cell arrives and commits to airborne use (any order).
Arrive(g) ==
    /\ g \in msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {g}
    /\ airborne' = airborne + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, depot>>

\* The token holder lands airborne fuel back into the depot.
Land(d) ==
    /\ token = d
    /\ airborne > 0
    /\ airborne' = airborne - 1
    /\ depot' = depot + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Launch(d)
    \/ \E g \in MsgIds : Arrive(g)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Land(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Fuel is conserved across depot, transit, and airborne.
FuelConserved == depot + Cardinality(msgs) + airborne = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    DroneCount = 2
    MsgIds = {g1, g2}
    Total = 3
INVARIANT FuelConserved
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m7p4t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cranes, Cap, MaxVer
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ MaxVer \in Nat

VARIABLES height, version, snap, locked
vars == <<height, version, snap, locked>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ height \in 0..(Cap + 2)
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ snap \in [Cranes -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ locked \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ height = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snap = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ locked = FALSE

\* A crane snapshots the live version.
ReadVer(c) ==
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<height, version, locked>>

\* Compare-and-swap push, respecting the lock and the capacity.
Push(c) ==
    /\ ~locked
    /\ snap[c] = version
    /\ height < Cap
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ height' = height + 1
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, locked>>

\* Compare-and-swap pop.
Pop(c) ==
    /\ snap[c] = version
    /\ height > 0
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ height' = height - 1
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, locked>>

\* Admin emergency clear.
AdminClear ==
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ height' = 0
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, locked>>

\* Admin lock toggle.
AdminLock ==
    /\ locked' = ~locked
    /\ UNCHANGED <<height, version, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : ReadVer(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Push(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Pop(c)
    \/ AdminClear
    \/ AdminLock

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The stack never exceeds capacity.
YardWithinCapacity == height <= Cap
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Cap = 3
    MaxVer = 4
INVARIANT YardWithinCapacity
SPECIFICATION Spec

spec_text:
---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m3p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Trains, MaxCap
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat

Vacant == "vacant"
TrainStates == {"idle", "queued", "injunction"}

VARIABLES leader, alive, pcs, cap
vars == <<leader, alive, pcs, cap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {Vacant}
    /\ alive \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ pcs \in [Trains -> TrainStates]
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ alive = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ pcs = [t \in Trains |-> "idle"]
    /\ cap = MaxCap

Elect(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ leader = Vacant
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, pcs, cap>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN Vacant ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pcs, cap>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, pcs, cap>>

\* Operations staff change the line capacity at runtime.
SetCap(k) ==
    /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, pcs>>

\* A train approaches and queues.
Approach(t) ==
    /\ pcs[t] = "idle"
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![t] = "queued"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, cap>>

\* Move a queued train into the empty junction, under a leader and capacity.
Enter(t) ==
    /\ pcs[t] = "queued"
    /\ leader # Vacant
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ \A u \in Trains : pcs[u] # "injunction"
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![t] = "injunction"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, cap>>

\* A train clears the junction and departs.
Depart(t) ==
    /\ pcs[t] = "injunction"
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, cap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(k)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Approach(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Enter(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Depart(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No two trains ever share the critical junction.
JunctionMutex ==
    \A t1, t2 \in Trains :
        (pcs[t1] = "injunction" /\ pcs[t2] = "injunction") => t1 = t2
=============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m0p5t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Cars, MaxVer, MaxCap
ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat /\ MaxCap \in Nat

Phases == {"queued", "ready", "done"}

VARIABLES version, snap, fin, cap, phase
vars == <<version, snap, fin, cap, phase>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ snap \in [Cars -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ fin \in [Cars -> 0..2]
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ phase \in [Cars -> Phases]

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snap = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ fin = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ cap = MaxCap
    /\ phase = [c \in Cars |-> "queued"]

\* Snapshot the config version for a car (start of the optimistic attempt).
Snapshot(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "queued"
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "ready"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, fin, cap>>

\* Configuration is bumped at runtime, invalidating outstanding snapshots.
BumpConfig ==
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, fin, cap, phase>>

\* Wash-bay capacity changes at runtime.
SetCap(k) ==
    /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, snap, fin, phase>>

\* Irreversible finalize: only on a matching snapshot, with capacity, once.
Finalize(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "ready"
    /\ snap[c] = version
    /\ fin[c] = 0
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ fin' = [fin EXCEPT ![c] = fin[c] + 1]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, snap, cap>>

\* Optimistic check failed: send the car back to retry.
Retry(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "ready"
    /\ snap[c] # version
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "queued"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, snap, fin, cap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Snapshot(c)
    \/ BumpConfig
    \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(k)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Finalize(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Retry(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The irreversible wax finalize happens at most once per car.
FinalizeAtMostOnce == \A c \in Cars : fin[c] <= 1
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {k1, k2}
    MaxVer = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INVARIANT FinalizeAtMostOnce
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m6p6t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, Printers, MaxClock, LeaseLen
ASSUME MaxClock \in Nat /\ LeaseLen \in Nat

Nobody == "nobody"

VARIABLES clock, owner, expiry, printedBy
vars == <<clock, owner, expiry, printedBy>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ owner \in [Printers -> Workers \cup {Nobody}]
    /\ expiry \in [Printers -> 0..(MaxClock + LeaseLen)]
    /\ printedBy \in [Printers -> Workers \cup {Nobody}]

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ owner = [p \in Printers |-> Nobody]
    /\ expiry = [p \in Printers |-> 0]
    /\ printedBy = [p \in Printers |-> Nobody]

Lapsed(p) == owner[p] = Nobody \/ expiry[p] <= clock

\* Acquire a free or lapsed printer, evicting any stale print record.
Acquire(w, p) ==
    /\ Lapsed(p)
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![p] = w]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![p] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ printedBy' = [printedBy EXCEPT ![p] = Nobody]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

\* Renew a live lease.
Renew(w, p) ==
    /\ owner[p] = w
    /\ expiry[p] > clock
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![p] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, owner, printedBy>>

\* Print only under a live lease held by this worker.
Print(w, p) ==
    /\ owner[p] = w
    /\ expiry[p] > clock
    /\ printedBy' = [printedBy EXCEPT ![p] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, owner, expiry>>

\* Admin override: forcibly reassign a printer, clearing the stale record.
AdminReassign(w, p) ==
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![p] = w]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![p] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ printedBy' = [printedBy EXCEPT ![p] = Nobody]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, printedBy>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : Acquire(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : Renew(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : Print(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : AdminReassign(w, p)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A recorded printer is always the printer's current lease owner.
NoStalePrint ==
    \A p \in Printers : printedBy[p] # Nobody => owner[p] = printedBy[p]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Workers = {u1, u2}
    Printers = {p1, p2}
    MaxClock = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
INVARIANT NoStalePrint
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m1p5t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS NodeCount
ASSUME NodeCount \in Nat

Nodes == 0..(NodeCount - 1)

VARIABLES token, held, alive, tripped, fired
vars == <<token, held, alive, tripped, fired>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ held \in BOOLEAN
    /\ alive \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ tripped \in BOOLEAN
    /\ fired \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ held = TRUE
    /\ alive = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ tripped = FALSE
    /\ fired = 0

\* The token advances one step around the ring.
PassToken ==
    /\ held
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % NodeCount
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, alive, tripped, fired>>

\* A node crashes silently, dropping the token if it held it.
Crash(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ held' = IF held /\ token = n THEN FALSE ELSE held
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, tripped, fired>>

\* A crashed node recovers.
Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, held, tripped, fired>>

\* A live node reclaims an unheld token.
Reclaim(n) ==
    /\ ~held
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ held' = TRUE
    /\ token' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, tripped, fired>>

\* The irreversible trip, only by a live token holder, only once.
Trip(n) ==
    /\ held
    /\ token = n
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ ~tripped
    /\ tripped' = TRUE
    /\ fired' = fired + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, held, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Reclaim(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Trip(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The irreversible trip fires at most once.
AtMostOneTrip == fired <= 1
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    NodeCount = 3
INVARIANT AtMostOneTrip
SPECIFICATION Spec

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m7p0t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Modulus
ASSUME Modulus \in Nat

Free == "free"

VARIABLES casReg, pcs, snap, gen
vars == <<casReg, pcs, snap, gen>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ casReg \in Drones \cup {Free}
    /\ pcs \in [Drones -> {"idle", "critical"}]
    /\ snap \in [Drones -> Drones \cup {Free}]
    /\ gen \in 0..(Modulus - 1)

Init ==
    /\ casReg = Free
    /\ pcs = [d \in Drones |-> "idle"]
    /\ snap = [d \in Drones |-> Free]
    /\ gen = 0

\* Observe the register into a local snapshot.
Observe(d) ==
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = casReg]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<casReg, pcs, gen>>

\* Compare-and-swap acquire: succeeds only if snapshot and register are free.
Acquire(d) ==
    /\ pcs[d] = "idle"
    /\ snap[d] = Free
    /\ casReg = Free
    /\ casReg' = d
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![d] = "critical"]
    /\ gen' = (gen + 1) % Modulus
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

\* Release the relay, freeing the register.
Release(d) ==
    /\ casReg = d
    /\ casReg' = Free
    /\ pcs' = [pcs EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, gen>>

\* CAS failed (snapshot stale): re-observe to retry.
Retry(d) ==
    /\ snap[d] = Free
    /\ casReg # Free
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = casReg]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<casReg, pcs, gen>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Observe(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Acquire(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Release(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Retry(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A drone is critical iff the register names it: at most one holder.
MutexCoherent ==
    \A d \in Drones : (pcs[d] = "critical") <=> (casReg = d)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2, d3}
    Modulus = 3
INVARIANT MutexCoherent
SPECIFICATION Spec
